sql.query: WITH je AS (SELECT fa.dateacct, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.dateacct, fa.fact_acct_group_id) AS entry_no, COALESCE(MAX(rlt.name), MAX(rl.name), MAX(dt.name), 'Journal') AS document_type, MAX(COALESCE(dt.docbasetype, CASE UPPER(adt.tablename) WHEN 'FIN_FINACC_TRANSACTION' THEN 'FAT' WHEN 'M_MATCHINV' THEN 'MXI' WHEN 'M_INVENTORY' THEN 'MMI' WHEN 'A_AMORTIZATION' THEN 'AMZ' ELSE NULL END)) AS docbasetype, MAX(dt.isreturn) AS isreturn, COALESCE(MAX(fa.description), '') AS entry_description, MAX(bp.name) AS bpname, MAX(p.name) AS productname, MAX(pj.name) AS projectname, MAX(cc.name) AS costcentername, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(adt.tablename) = 'C_INVOICE' THEN CASE WHEN dt.issotrx = 'Y' THEN 'sales-invoice' ELSE 'purchase-invoice' END WHEN UPPER(adt.tablename) = 'M_INOUT' THEN CASE WHEN dt.isreturn = 'Y' THEN CASE WHEN dt.issotrx = 'Y' THEN 'return-material-receipt' ELSE 'return-to-vendor-shipment' END ELSE CASE WHEN dt.issotrx = 'Y' THEN 'goods-shipment' ELSE 'goods-receipt' END END WHEN UPPER(adt.tablename) = 'M_INVENTORY' THEN 'physical-inventory' WHEN UPPER(adt.tablename) = 'M_MATCHINV' THEN 'matched-purchase-invoices' WHEN UPPER(adt.tablename) = 'A_AMORTIZATION' THEN 'amortization' WHEN UPPER(adt.tablename) = 'FIN_FINACC_TRANSACTION' THEN 'financial-account' ELSE NULL END) AS doc_window, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(adt.tablename) = 'FIN_FINACC_TRANSACTION' THEN fat.fin_financial_account_id ELSE fa.record_id END) AS doc_record_id, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(adt.tablename) = 'FIN_FINACC_TRANSACTION' THEN 'txnAny' ELSE NULL END) AS doc_query_key, fa.fact_acct_group_id, fa.record_id, fa.ad_table_id, fa.acctvalue AS account_no, fa.acctdescription AS account_name, SUM(fa.amtacctdr) AS amtacctdr, SUM(fa.amtacctcr) AS amtacctcr, MIN(fa.seqno) AS min_seqno FROM fact_acct fa LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.c_doctype_id = fa.c_doctype_id LEFT JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id = fa.c_bpartner_id LEFT JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id = fa.m_product_id LEFT JOIN c_project pj ON pj.c_project_id = fa.c_project_id LEFT JOIN c_costcenter cc ON cc.c_costcenter_id = fa.c_costcenter_id LEFT JOIN ad_table adt ON adt.ad_table_id = fa.ad_table_id LEFT JOIN fin_finacc_transaction fat ON fat.fin_finacc_transaction_id = fa.record_id LEFT JOIN ad_ref_list rl ON rl.ad_reference_id = '183' AND rl.value = COALESCE(dt.docbasetype, CASE UPPER(adt.tablename) WHEN 'FIN_FINACC_TRANSACTION' THEN 'FAT' WHEN 'M_MATCHINV' THEN 'MXI' WHEN 'M_INVENTORY' THEN 'MMI' WHEN 'A_AMORTIZATION' THEN 'AMZ' ELSE NULL END) LEFT JOIN ad_ref_list_trl rlt ON rlt.ad_ref_list_id = rl.ad_ref_list_id AND rlt.ad_language = '__REPORT_LOCALE__' WHERE fa.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') AND (('__SHOWREGULARENTRIES__' = 'true' AND fa.factaccttype = 'N') OR ('__SHOWPLCLOSINGENTRIES__' = 'true' AND fa.factaccttype = 'R') OR ('__SHOWCLOSINGENTRIES__' = 'true' AND fa.factaccttype = 'C') OR ('__SHOWOPENINGENTRIES__' = 'true' AND fa.factaccttype = 'O') OR ('__SHOWDIVIDEUPENTRIES__' = 'true' AND fa.factaccttype = 'D') OR ('__SHOWREGULARENTRIES__' <> 'true' AND '__SHOWPLCLOSINGENTRIES__' <> 'true' AND '__SHOWCLOSINGENTRIES__' <> 'true' AND '__SHOWOPENINGENTRIES__' <> 'true' AND '__SHOWDIVIDEUPENTRIES__' <> 'true' AND fa.factaccttype = 'N')) AND ('__DATEFROM__' = '' OR fa.dateacct >= '__DATEFROM__'::date) AND ('__DATETO__' = '' OR fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date) AND ('__ORGID__' = '' OR fa.ad_org_id = '__ORGID__') AND ('__ACCTSCHEMAID__' = '' OR fa.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__') AND ('__BPARTNERID__' = '' OR fa.c_bpartner_id = '__BPARTNERID__') AND ('__PRODUCTID__' = '' OR fa.m_product_id = '__PRODUCTID__') AND ('__PROJECTID__' = '' OR fa.c_project_id = '__PROJECTID__') AND ('__COSTCENTERID__' = '' OR fa.c_costcenter_id = '__COSTCENTERID__') AND ('__FACTACCTGROUPID__' = '' OR fa.fact_acct_group_id = '__FACTACCTGROUPID__') AND ('__FROMACCOUNTID__' = '' OR fa.acctvalue >= '__FROMACCOUNTID__') AND ('__TOACCOUNTID__' = '' OR fa.acctvalue <= '__TOACCOUNTID__') GROUP BY fa.fact_acct_group_id, fa.dateacct, fa.acctvalue, fa.acctdescription, fa.record_id, fa.ad_table_id, fa.account_id, fa.factaccttype, (CASE fa.amtacctdr WHEN 0 THEN (CASE SIGN(fa.amtacctcr) WHEN -1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) ELSE (CASE SIGN(fa.amtacctdr) WHEN -1 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END) END) HAVING (SUM(fa.amtacctdr) <> 0 OR SUM(fa.amtacctcr) <> 0)) SELECT dateacct, entry_no, document_type, docbasetype, isreturn, doc_window, doc_record_id, doc_query_key, entry_description, bpname, productname, projectname, costcentername, fact_acct_group_id, record_id, ad_table_id, account_no, account_name, amtacctdr, amtacctcr FROM je ORDER BY dateacct, fact_acct_group_id, min_seqno
